description: Tamil Nadu's ₹40 crore AI platform aims to unify planning authorities, coordinate inspections and reduce approval delays for real estate developers across the state.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu is set to adopt an AI-based platform to fast-track building-plan approvals. The proposed system is expected to be launched within six to seven months. Called Single Platform for Efficient Expedited Development (SPEED), the initiative seeks to bring planning authorities and departments that give clearances on board a common digital interface.
